methodology.confirmedDefinition: A visit is confirmed by direct recollection of the named restaurant. The starred-venues counter requires a confirmed visit to a restaurant awarded at least one Michelin star in the guide edition matching the remembered visit period.
methodology.guideVsStar: Michelin Selected, Bib Gourmand, Green Star and Michelin Stars are separate distinctions; Michelin Selected is not a Michelin star.
methodology.editionCaveat: A restaurant may earn its star partway through a year. The starred-venues counter describes the venue's guide recognition, not proof that the star was already awarded on the dinner date.
methodology.unreconciled: An unidentified venue is not counted as a confirmed starred venue. When only an approximate year is recalled, whether the star existed on the precise meal date is preserved as unverified.

entries.name: République
entries.summary: A confirmed visit to a Michelin Guide-listed restaurant. It is Michelin Selected, not Michelin-starred in the 2026 Guide.

entries.name: New York City · Michelin burger memory
entries.summary: A single 2016/17 Michelin burger-restaurant visit. The Spotted Pig visually looks familiar, but Alex also remembers white tablecloths and an almost Italian atmosphere; the venue is not yet resolved.

candidates.name: The Spotted Pig
candidates.reason: Alex recognizes the venue as familiar; its dining room had white tablecloths, but it was primarily an English-style gastropub. Held a star in the 2016 guide, downgraded for 2017.

candidates.name: Minetta Tavern
candidates.reason: Strong match for white linen and the nearly Italian feel: the vintage brasserie originated as an Italian restaurant and saloon. Famous Black Label Burger; one star in 2016 and 2017.

candidates.name: The Breslin
candidates.reason: April Bloomfield's celebrated lamb burger; starred in both editions.

excludedResearch.explanation: Michelin did not publish any US restaurant guide until 2005. No Wisconsin Dells restaurant could hold a US Michelin star in the late 1990s.
